content:
Ganpati Bappa once got offended by a laugh.

And honestly, the story is surprisingly relatable. 😂

After a feast, Ganesha was riding back on his mouse when he stumbled and fell.

The Moon saw him and laughed.

Ganesha got angry and cursed the Moon, saying that anyone who looked at the Moon on that particular day would face false accusations.

But later, Ganesha realised the consequences of the curse and softened it.

And there’s something interesting in that story.

One person's laugh triggered a reaction.

But Ganesha eventually chose to change that reaction.

Sometimes we say things we don't mean.

Sometimes we hurt people without realising it.

Sometimes we understand our mistake only afterwards.

Maybe that's the lesson I'll take from Bappa this Ganesh Chaturthi:

Try to forgive.

Because life is already heavy enough.
We don't need to carry every old hurt with us.
